# Validation Policy

Use this instruction set when the user asks for validation tests/regression validation.

The assigned validation agent is responsible for timeline orchestration and skill invocation.

## Isolation Rules

- During generation, never read `expected-outputs/`.
- Do not write validation artifacts into top-level `outputs/`.
- Keep each case isolated under `workflow-validation/<case>/`.
- Do not upload validation outputs to GitHub repositories.

## Report Requirements

- Report file: `workflow-validation/validation-report.md`
- Template: `.github/validation-workflow-template.md`
- Required first line:

FILE IS GENERATED BY WORKFLOW VALIDATION - DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

- Ensure every case has `generated-outputs/`.
- Keep assessment qualitative only (no numeric scores, no pass/fail verdict).
